sources.citation: Masele, Balla F. Y. P. 2001. The linguistic history of SiSuumbwa, KiSukuma and KiNyamweezi in Bantu Zone F. PhD thesis, Memorial University of Newfoundland. (already held by the project under and; p.73 verified on page render)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Only a zone-wide remark p.73: 'Most Zone F languages have a 7-vowel system with a short-long vowel contrast.. All the languages in the zone are also tonal, but the tones are not always shown'. Kimbu appears only in classification lists and in a quotation of Shorter 1972:xix (Shorter had to devise a Kimbu orthography because 'virtually no language recording had been done in Ukimbu').
